comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Likely related to the status cache introduced last sprint; checking cache invalidation order.

content.text: Likely related to the status cache introduced last sprint; checking cache invalidation order.
Tickets in the support portal remain stuck on Waiting even after an agent posts a public reply that should move them to Pending customer or Open.
Status transition logs show the reply event without a matching status update when the ticket was previously Waiting on customer.
Identify the race between the reply writer and the status machine and ensure agent replies always advance status for portal-visible tickets.
